_description.summary: World block interaction: raycasts to blocks and entities, breaking, collecting, placing and freezing blocks, block properties (hardness, blast resistance, blockstates, facets, map color), dyeing, meshes, falling blocks, fluid raycasts, armor stand control, paper planes and time bombs.
use_cases: Finding which block or entity is at a position or in the line of sight
Breaking, collecting, placing or freezing blocks

hexcasting:raycast.d: Combines two vectors (a position and a direction) into the answer to the question: If I stood at the position and looked in the direction, what block would I be looking at? Costs a negligible amount of media.

hexcasting:raycast/axis.d: Like Archer's Distillation, but instead returns a vector representing the answer to the question: Which *side* of the block am I looking at? Costs a negligible amount of media.

hexcasting:break_block.d:
Remove a location from the stack, then break the block at the given location. This spell can break nearly anything a Diamond Pickaxe can break.
Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust, or a negligible amount if breaking a Conjured Block or Conjured Light.

dthexcasting:get_species.d: Provided a tree's position, I can extract the Species of the tree.

dthexcasting:get_jocode.d: Provided a tree's position, I can extract the structure of the tree as a Base64 string.

hexical:dye.d: Dyes a dyeable block or entity. Costs about an eighth of one Amethyst Dust.

hexical:translate_dye.d: Translates a dye color into a vector, where each component is from 0 to 1 and represents the red, green, and blueness of the dye respectively.

hexical:break_silk.d: Breaks a block gently, perserving the block better than standard mining. Costs about half of an Amethyst Dust.

hexical:weave_mesh.d: Takes a list of vectors, with constraints defined on the prior page, and weaves the mesh into that shape. Free.

hexical:read_mesh.d: Pushes the shape of a mesh as a list of vectors.

hexpose:block_hardness.d: Pushes how difficult blocks of this type are to mine.

hexpose:block_blast_resistance.d: Pushes how resistant blocks of this type are to explosions.

hexpose:blockstate_rotation.d: Pushes the vector of the block's facing direction, or Null if blocks of its type do not have an orientation.

hexpose:blockstate_crop.d: Pushes a number 0 to 1 corresponding to the growth progress of that block. Works for crops, Beehives, Composters, Cauldrons, and strangely Cakes too.

hexpose:get_blockstates.d: Pushes a list of all facets of that block.

hexpose:query_blockstate.d: Takes a block and a facet and pushes that facet's value.

hexpose:block_map_color.d: Pushes the color blocks of this type appear as on a map.

hierophantics:make_break_trigger.d: Creates a trigger that activates whenever I break a block.

lapisworks:empty_prfn.d: Answers the question, "is there only air there?" for negligible media cost. Vector must be in my ambit.

lapisworks:empty_dstl.d: Negligible cost. Answers the question, "are there no opaque blocks between these points?". Both vectors must be in my ambit.

lapisworks:visible_dstl.d: Negligible cost. Pushes whether or not the specified entity (within ambit) is able to see the specified block (also within ambit).

yaha:paper_plane.d: Summons a projectile that slowly flies towards the given entity, dealing 3 hearts of damage. Costs one Amethyst Dust. Adds itself onto the stack.

yaha:paper_plane_target.d: Returns the target of a paper plane, or null if it does not have one.

yaha:time_bomb.d: Summons a floating projectile that casts after a given duration. Costs one Charged Amethyst, plus the media given to the bomb. Adds itself onto the stack.

yaha:time_bomb_pos.d: Returns the position of the time bomb casting this pattern. Mishaps if not cast by a bomb.

yaha:anvil.d: Summons an anvil that deals damage based on its velocity. Damage dealt never goes above 10 hearts. Costs one Charged Amethyst. Adds itself onto the stack.

yaha:trident.d: Summons a trident that pierces mobs and pulls them inwards. Costs one Charged Amethyst. Adds itself onto the stack.

yaha:sussify_block.d: Buries the item entity into a sand or gravel block, forming suspicious sand/gravel. Costs an eighth of an Amethyst Dust.

yaha:potion_to_item.d: Plucks a potion out of the air, turning it into an item entity. Costs one Charged Amethyst.

yaha:stand_toggle_arms.d: Gives the armor stand arms. Casting again removes the armor stand's arms.

yaha:stand_toggle_base.d: Vanishes the stone baseplate supporting the armor stand. Casting again rematerializes the baseplate.

yaha:stand_toggle_tiny.d: Gives the armor stand a smaller form. Casting again brings it back to its original size.

yaha:stand_rotate_head.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's head; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's torso.

yaha:stand_rotate_body.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's head; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's torso.

yaha:stand_rotate_yaw.d: Faces the armor stand towards the given yaw in radians, where south is 0 rad, west is π/2 rad, north is π rad, and east is -π/2 rad.

yaha:stand_rotate_left_arm.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's left arm; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's right arm.

yaha:stand_rotate_right_arm.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's left arm; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's right arm.

yaha:stand_rotate_left_leg.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's left leg; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's right leg.

yaha:stand_rotate_right_leg.d: The pattern with the left protrusion orients the armor stand's left leg; the pattern with the right protrusion orients the armor stand's right leg.

mediatransport:recv_fsb.d: Retrieves the next iota from the inbound queue, or mishaps if the queue is empty.
